ex.en: The Prophet, may Allah bless him and grand him peace, said, "O people, God is good, and he accepts only good things. God has charged the believers with what he charged the messengers, for he said then, 'O messengers, eat good things and do good. I am well-informed of what you do', and he has said, 'O believers, eat from the good things that we have bestowed upon you.' Then he spoke of a man who would travel overmuch, a shaggy, dust-covered man who would stretch out his hands to the heavens: "My Lord! My Lord!" Yet, his food had been unlawful, his drink had been unlawful, his clothing had been unlawful, and he had been nourished with unlawfulness. "How would such a one ever be answered?"
